name: AML / KYC & OFAC Sanctions Screening Compliance
description: Compliance framework for the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), USA PATRIOT Act, FinCEN Customer Due Diligence (CDD) rule, OFAC sanctions screening, and EU AML Directives, covering PEP screening, real-time transaction monitoring, and SAR/CTR filings.
owner: Global Financial Crime & AML Compliance Office

checklists.name: AML / KYC & OFAC Sanctions Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for BSA, FinCEN CDD Rule, OFAC sanctions, and EU AML Directive requirements.

items.statement: Real-time sanctions screening checks all senders, beneficiaries, and intermediaries against OFAC SDN and global lists.
Customer Identification Program (CIP) verifies government photo IDs and national tax IDs prior to account activation.
FinCEN CDD rule identifies and verifies all 25%+ beneficial owners for legal entity customers.
Suspicious Activity Reporting (SAR) workflow automatically files SAR reports with FinCEN within 30 days of detection.
Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) and adverse media screening is re-evaluated daily against updated databases.

reviewGates.name: BSA / AML Compliance Officer Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Designated BSA / AML Officer confirms that sanctions screening, KYC workflows, and SAR reporting comply with FinCEN and OFAC rules.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the AML audit evidence confirm full compliance with BSA, FinCEN CDD, and OFAC sanctions requirements?
